body:
Hi there, it's been a while on this issue - wondering if this is on the team's radar still? We can work around some of these by, e.g., wrapping `<Breadcrumb>` in a `<nav aria-label="..">` of our own, but some stuff I have come across that I can't control:

- `<Pagination>` doesn't specify `aria-current="page"`
- Can't add `aria-label` to `<Hits>` (the `<ol>`, specifically)
- Using our own button to clear `<SearchBox>` with `useSearchBox` can't be tied to underlying `<input>` with `aria-controls`

I definitely wouldn't say any of these are critical, except perhaps the `aria-current="page"` which is definitely an oversight.
